title: 茶水间英文 - 11月13日 | 微软大宕机、英伟达接班难题、苏格兰圆梦
description:
Microsoft 365 went down around the world on Thursday, locking millions out of Outlook and Teams, while Nvidia picked up the pieces after its founder's resignation with no succession plan in sight. And in happier news, Scotland are going to the World Cup for the first time in twenty-eight years after a wild four-two win over Denmark. Plus a random question: if your phone could talk, what would it say to you first thing in the morning?

微软 365 周四全球大宕机，Outlook 和 Teams 集体罢工，无数打工人一早发现邮箱打不开；英伟达则在创始人辞职后手忙脚乱接班，三十三年里居然从没准备过接班计划。好消息也有：苏格兰在一场疯狂的四比二之后，时隔二十八年重返世界杯。今天还有一个随机问题：如果你的手机会说话，一大早它会对你说什么？

Words to steal 生词本：
- go down — 宕机；出故障
- bounce back — 反弹；恢复
- roll back — 回滚；撤销（变更）
- succession plan — 接班计划
- interim — 临时的；代理的
- closed-door — 闭门的；不公开的
- stoppage time — 补时；伤停补时
- catch up — 赶上进度；补上
